context.encoding: One isolated Node process per new corpus/level. Brotli-11 and level 9 reuse validated frozen encodings. Level 19 was regenerated and matches its old encoded SHA-256. Encode times and RSS are single diagnostics.
context.decoding: Fresh Node process per corpus/codec/repetition; rotating corpus and codec order. No compression during timing. Includes output allocation, excludes I/O, hash/output comparisons, Rust load, and teardown.
context.input: Same portable payload SHA-256 as the previous Rust matrix. Every measured decode compares every output byte.

windowLimit.w23: ZSTD_c_windowLog=23; actual headers and ZSTD_d_windowLogMax=23 decoding verified. No browser or HTTP integration benchmark.

context.rss: Node process.resourceUsage().maxRSS in KiB; decoder peaks include input construction, retained encoded/raw buffers, all warmups and samples, allocator high-water marks and GC. Not intrinsic codec workspace.
limits: Local Node native codecs, not Rust or browser decoding.
Higher default levels can produce nonconforming HTTP content-encoding windows; default level does not itself specify compatibility.
RSS/encode timings are diagnostic, not repeated encoder benchmarks.
Core placement, thermals and unrelated host activity were not controlled.
